jobs.prompt: Write the 06h report as a zen-inbox note: plan for the day and the path (board In Progress, To Do by priority, Human Only steps, open decisions).
Write the 12h report as a zen-inbox note: what is done so far today.
Write the 18h report as a zen-inbox note: what was done today and what to expect tomorrow.
Run the weekly refresh of the uncensored-model value survey.

Weekly board sweep: run `zen-board stale --days 14 --json` and file ONE cockpit zen-inbox ask listing every stale task (number, title, age, last note) with a Won't Do / fold / keep choice per task. Nothing stale: no ask. Apply the answers with `zen-board wontdo <id> --note` or a fold note.
